nodes.title: 🔀 Bypassers & Mute

en.text:
Turn whole parts of a workflow on and off from one place. ✋ Use these instead of bypassing nodes by hand.

**LC Bypasser**
- Bypasses linked nodes from one place with toggles or BOOLEAN inputs.

**LC Mute**
- Works like LC Bypasser, but Off mutes the linked nodes instead of bypassing them.

**LC Groups Bypasser**
- Bypasses whole groups from one place, with one toggle per group.

**LC Bypasser Panel**
- A widgets-only remote for LC Bypasser, LC Mute or LC Groups Bypasser.

**LC Bypass Relay**
- Gathers nodes on its left so a hub can mute or bypass all of them together through OPT_CONNECTION.

zh.text:
在一个地方开关工作流的整块区域。✋ 用它们，别再手动 bypass 节点了。

**LC Bypasser**
- 通过开关或 BOOLEAN 输入，在一处 bypass 所有链接的节点。

**LC Mute**
- 用法与 LC Bypasser 相同，但关闭时是 mute 链接的节点，而不是 bypass。

**LC Groups Bypasser**
- 在一处 bypass 整个 group，每个 group 一个开关。

**LC Bypasser Panel**
- LC Bypasser、LC Mute 或 LC Groups Bypasser 的纯 widget 遥控器。

**LC Bypass Relay**
- 收集左侧的节点，让中枢通过 OPT_CONNECTION 一次性 mute 或 bypass 它们。

nodes.title: ✅ Booleans

en.text:
True / false and everything you do with it.

**LC Boolean Value**
- A plain boolean toggle you can wire anywhere.

**LC Boolean**
- Turns a boolean, int or float into a clean true/false and shows it on the node.

**LC Boolean Flip**
- Outputs the opposite of its toggle.

**LC Invert Boolean**
- Coerces a boolean, int or float and outputs the opposite.

**LC Boolean Switch**
- Picks the on_true or on_false input (any type) based on a boolean.
- 💡 rename the socket or plug a named node in and that is what the boolean widget says instead of *true* or *false* 

**LC 🚦** light
- A light for a boolean: one color for true, one for false (or none). 
- designed to go over parts of your workflow that get bypassed by a boolean and not a mute/bypass so you can tell what the hell it is using 
- click the ⚙️ to change the settings
   - 💡take two and invert the 🔴 & 🟢 and plug it into the same boolean output

**LC Is Bypassed / Muted**
- Outputs true if the node wired into it is bypassed or muted, read live without queuing.

zh.text:
真 / 假，以及围绕它做的一切。

**LC Boolean Value**
- 一个朴素的布尔开关，可以接到任何地方。

**LC Boolean**
- 把布尔、整数或浮点数转成干净的 true/false，并显示在节点上。

**LC Boolean Flip**
- 输出其开关的相反值。

**LC Invert Boolean**
- 把布尔、整数或浮点数转为布尔后输出相反值。

**LC Boolean Switch**
- 根据布尔值选择 on_true 或 on_false 输入（任意类型）。
- 💡 重命名插槽，或接入一个有名字的节点，布尔控件就会显示那个名字，而不是 *true* 或 *false* 

**LC 🚦** 指示灯
- 布尔值的指示灯：true 一种颜色，false 一种颜色（或者没有）。 
- 设计用来盖在工作流中被布尔值（而不是静音/绕过）控制的部分上面，这样你就能看出到底用的是哪一个 
- 点击 ⚙️ 更改设置
   - 💡再拿一个，把 🔴 和 🟢 反过来，接到同一个布尔输出上

**LC Is Bypassed / Muted**
- 如果接入的节点被绕过或静音就输出 true，实时读取，无需排队。

nodes.title: 🔁 Switches

en.text:
Pick one of several inputs, or test whether something is empty.

**LC AnySwitch**
- Picks the first connected input out of 2 to 20 and locks to its type.

**LC Any Index Switch**
- Passes through the input at the chosen index and ignores the other slots.

**LC Any Empty Bool**
- Outputs true if any connected input is empty, muted or bypassed.

**LC Any Empty Int**
- Runs the same empty test as Any Empty Bool and outputs an empty and a not-empty integer.

**LC Any Empty Float**
- Runs the same empty test as Any Empty Bool and outputs an empty and a not-empty float.

zh.text:
从多个输入中选一个，或测试某样东西是否为空。

**LC AnySwitch**
- 在 2 到 20 个输入里选第一个已连接的，并锁定为它的类型。

**LC Any Index Switch**
- 透传所选索引的输入，忽略其他插槽。

**LC Any Empty Bool**
- 只要任一连接的输入为空、被静音或被绕过，就输出 true。

**LC Any Empty Int**
- 用与 Any Empty Bool 相同的判空逻辑，输出一个“空”整数和一个“非空”整数。

**LC Any Empty Float**
- 用与 Any Empty Bool 相同的判空逻辑，输出一个“空”浮点数和一个“非空”浮点数。

nodes.title: 🔢 Numbers & Choices

en.text:
Sliders, compares and dropdowns you can wire anywhere.

**LC Slider**
- A slider on the node face that outputs an int or float.

**LC Control Panel 🎛️**
- Up to 16 sliders on one node, each on its own output. The gear on a row sets its name, range, step and INT or FLOAT. A new row plugged into a number input copies that input's settings.
- ❓ detailers.... I like control. 

**LC Size Pad 📐**
- A 2D slider for width x height. It's pinned to the bottom-left: drag the top-right corner (or click the pad).
- Model presets (MiniMax H3, Krea 2, SDXL, LTX, Klein 9B, Wan 2.2) snap to that model's step and stop at its megapixel limit.
- 💡 Wire width and height into any latent or resize node.

**LC Int Compare**
- Outputs the larger or smaller of two integers.
- useful for resizing or aspect ratio changes

**LC Float Compare**
- Outputs the larger or smaller of two floats.
- same as above

**LC Int Split**
- Splits a total into a + b at a fractional split point, so a + b always equals the total.
- lol, I forgot I made this 🤔. **Step swap by percentages**

**LC Combo Selector**
- A dropdown that mirrors the options of another node's combo (sampler, scheduler, etc.) when wired into it.

**LC Custom Combo**
- Builds your own list of options and outputs the chosen text and its index.
- use this with any index when you want yor choices to be words instead of numbers (i.e. different prompt types: *Portrait, Cinematic, PG-13, NSFW,* ...)

**LC Custom Combo Panel**
- A remote control that picks the choice for an LC Custom Combo from another spot.
- ❓because I hate spaghetti and when a node has like 20 sockets on it. *offshoot of RGthree node collector*

zh.text:
可以接到任何地方的滑块、比较节点和下拉菜单。

**LC Slider**
- 节点表面上的滑块，输出 int 或 float。

**LC Control Panel 🎛️**
- 一个节点上最多 16 个滑块，每个都有自己的输出。点行上的齿轮可以设置名称、范围、步长以及 INT 或 FLOAT。把新的一行接到某个数字输入上，会复制该输入的设置。
- ❓ detailers.... 我喜欢掌控感。

**LC Size Pad 📐**
- 宽 x 高的二维滑块。左下角固定：拖动右上角（或直接点击面板）。
- 模型预设（MiniMax H3、Krea 2、SDXL、LTX、Klein 9B、Wan 2.2）会吸附到该模型的步长，并停在其百万像素上限。
- 💡 把宽和高接到任何 latent 或 resize 节点上。

**LC Int Compare**
- 输出两个整数中较大或较小的一个。
- 适用于缩放或宽高比调整

**LC Float Compare**
- 输出两个浮点数中较大或较小的一个。
- 同上

**LC Int Split**
- 按小数分割点把总数拆成 a + b，所以 a + b 永远等于总数。
- 哈哈，我都忘了做过这个 🤔。**按百分比切换步数（step swap）**

**LC Combo Selector**
- 一个下拉菜单，接入另一个节点的 combo（采样器、调度器等）后，会镜像其选项。

**LC Custom Combo**
- 建立你自己的选项列表，输出所选文本及其索引。
- 想让选项用文字而不是数字时，可以配合任意索引使用（比如不同的提示词类型：*Portrait, Cinematic, PG-13, NSFW,* ...）

**LC Custom Combo Panel**
- 一个遥控器，可以在别处为 LC Custom Combo 选择选项。
- ❓因为我讨厌意大利面式的连线，也讨厌一个节点上有 20 个接口。*源自 RGthree 的节点收集器*

nodes.title: 🛑 Flow Control

en.text:
Pause, pass through, time and clean up a run.

**LC Stop 🛑**
- A queue breakpoint you can enable to pause until you continue.
- designed when you are rough drafting before sending the image through teh RAM heavy detailer or upscalers
- 💡⚠️ only works on a fixed seed 🌱

**LC Image Pass**
- Passes an image straight through, and its enable switch mutes what hangs off it downstream.
- basically toggles a path of travel to prevent a mask or image from being picked up when you have multiple options. I use this ans Mask pass mainly when I want the option of bypasssing a mask generator (i.e. LC skin Beauty node)

**LC Mask Pass**
- Same as above, but for masks

**LC VRAM Cache Clear**
- A pass-through node that clears GPU and model cache when it runs, also on its own branch with nothing after it.
- created to eliminate the need fora seperate *VRAM clear* and *clear cache all* nodes

**LC Timer ⏱️**
- Times every run and scores the newest one against the 5 before it: faster in green, slower in red. 
- Stopped and fully cached runs are left out.

**LC Notify 🔊**
- Plays a chosen sound when the node runs (always, on empty queue, or never).
- hook this up after certain parts of your workflow so you don't have to sit there and watch it process. 
-

zh.text:
暂停、直通、计时，并清理一次运行。

**LC Stop 🛑**
- 一个队列断点，启用后会暂停，直到你点继续。
- 设计用途：在草稿阶段，先不要把图送去占内存的 detailer 或放大器
- 💡⚠️ 只在固定 seed 🌱 下有效

**LC Image Pass**
- 让图像直接通过，它的启用开关会把下游挂在它后面的东西静音。
- 基本上就是切换一条通路，避免在有多个选项时 mask 或图像被错误选中。我主要用它和 Mask pass，在我想要能够跳过某个 mask 生成器（比如 LC skin Beauty 节点）的时候。

**LC Mask Pass**
- 同上，但用于 mask

**LC VRAM Cache Clear**
- 一个直通节点，运行时清理 GPU 和模型缓存，即使挂在后面没有任何东西的独立分支上也能工作。
- 做它是为了不再需要单独的 *VRAM clear* 和 *clear cache all* 节点

**LC Timer ⏱️**
- 给每次运行计时，并把最新一次与之前 5 次比较打分：更快显示绿色，更慢显示红色。 
- 被停止的和完全命中缓存的运行不计入。

**LC Notify 🔊**
- 节点运行时播放选定的声音（总是、队列为空时、或从不）。
- 把它接在工作流的某些部分之后，就不用坐在那里盯着处理了。 
-

nodes.title: About this workflow 👋

en.text:
# LC123 Examples - Logic & Switches

Bypassers, booleans, switches and the little number tools that make a workflow run itself.

- These are examples of every node in each section, with a short note on what it does. They are not wired: drop the ones you need into your own workflow.
- 💡 Hover any input for its tooltip. Full details in the [README](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes).

**In this workflow:**
- 🔀 Bypassers & Mute
- ✅ Booleans
- 🔁 Switches
- 🔢 Numbers & Choices
- 🛑 Flow Control

zh.text:
# LC123 示例 - 逻辑与开关

Bypasser、布尔、开关，以及那些让工作流自己运转的小数字工具。

- 每个分区里都有每个节点的示例，并附有简短说明。它们没有连线：把需要的拖进你自己的工作流即可。
- 💡 把鼠标悬停在任意输入上可以看到提示。完整说明见 [README](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)。

**本工作流包含：**
- 🔀 Bypasser 与静音
- ✅ 布尔
- 🔁 开关
- 🔢 数字与选项
- 🛑 流程控制

nodes.title: LC Notify 🔊

en.text:
**LC Notify 🔊**
- hook to any node outlet.
- plays a selected sound upon completion
- select from a list of preloaded sounds or place your own in the folder shown below



```
📂 ComfyUI/
│── 📂 custom_nodes
│   ├── 📂 ComfyUI_LC123_nodes
│   │      └── 📂 assets
│   │             └──📂 sounds
│   │                   └── any .mp3 sound
```

zh.text:
**LC Notify 🔊**
- 接到任意节点的输出口上。
- 完成时播放你选的提示音
- 可以从预置音效列表里选，也可以把自己的音效放进下面这个文件夹



```
📂 ComfyUI/
│── 📂 custom_nodes
│   ├── 📂 ComfyUI_LC123_nodes
│   │      └── 📂 assets
│   │             └──📂 sounds
│   │                   └── any .mp3 sound
```
